scenes.line1: Can you trace data issues fast?
scenes.say: Can you quickly trace data issues? Let’s see why data lineage and catalogs matter for engineers.

scenes.label: Lineage
scenes.sub: Shows how data moves and transforms across systems.
scenes.say: Data lineage shows how data flows and transforms across systems. It helps you trace sources and dependencies.
A data catalog documents datasets, schemas, owners, and metadata. This makes data easier to find and govern.

scenes.title: Sample Data Flow
scenes.say: A lineage graph might show data flowing from raw sales to cleaned sales, then to sales aggregates.

scenes.question: What does a catalog entry include?
scenes.right: Table columns, data types, owner, and metadata.
scenes.say: Interviewers may ask what a catalog entry includes. It’s more than just names and owners—remember columns, types, and metadata.
